title: A one-sided constrained martingale transport between two uniform laws
summary: We minimize $\mathbb E[h(Y-X)]$ over martingale couplings of $\text{Unif}[-1,1]$ and $\text{Unif}[-2,2]$ satisfying $Y\geq X-k$, where $h\in C^1([-3,3])$ has convex derivative. Feasibility holds exactly for $k\geq1$. For each such $k$, we construct a coupling that minimizes all costs in this class. For $1<k<3$, its support consists of two graphs, with $D(x)=x-k$ on $[k-2,1]$. The maps admit an explicit parametrization for $2\leq k<3$ and are determined by scalar equations with unique admissible roots for $1<k<2$.
